articles.title: TVK govt junks tender for training campus in Chennai
articles.description: The cancellation comes after the TVK government's reported decision to review tenders finalised during the last six months of the previous regime.

articles.title: Toxic froth returns to Yamuna, AAP alleges tender irregularities in anti-froth drive
articles.description: AAP Delhi chief Saurabh Bharadwaj said the tendering process for treating the Yamuna Froth near Kalindi Kunj was still underway and the financial bid had not yet been opened.

articles.title: Coal Controller Organisation Recognized for Mine Land Repurposing Tool
articles.description: The Coal Controller Organisation has received a national award for its SUVIKALP tool, designed to assist in the sustainable repurposing of post-mining land.
